note: Top navigation bar -- renders: GitLab logo, search box, 'New' button, dashboard shortcuts (Issues/MRs/Todos), Help, and user avatar; all labels are fixed platform vocabulary

Left sidebar navigation -- renders: fixed project section links (Information, Repository, Issues, Merge requests, Pipelines, etc.); the project name in the context header is user-defined and subtracted
Breadcrumb navigation -- renders: project namespace and section names (e.g., 'a11yproject', 'Issues'); these are project identifiers defined by the operator or project owner, not free-form UGC
Issue list filter tabs -- renders: fixed state filters ('Open', 'Closed', 'All') with counts; the tab labels are platform vocabulary
Toolbar controls above the issue list -- renders: fixed action buttons ('New issue', 'Sort', 'Filter', 'Export', etc.); excludes the issue list items which contain user-generated titles and metadata
Pagination controls -- renders: 'Previous', 'Next', and page size dropdown; fixed platform vocabulary
